# Mapterhorn pipeline over GEM-15: three test areas

> An experiment, not a Mapterhorn release. Six terrarium-encoded terrain
> PMTiles archives, a surface and a bare-earth model over each of three
> areas, built by running GEM-15 elevation COGs through the
> Mapterhorn terrain pipeline from an unmerged fork
> (github.com/cholmes/mapterhorn, branch gem-15-source, built at commit
> 86d8494, forked from upstream main at 2c4195d). The Mapterhorn project
> did not review, merge or endorse them. Built and measured 2026-11-15.

Key facts

- Three areas: Catalonia (4 GEM-15 cells, max zoom 12), Cusco (1 cell, 13),
  High Atlas (1 cell, 13). Each area has a surface model (DSM) and a
  bare-earth model (DTM), pixel-aligned, same max zoom and tile count.
  The DSM set built in 28 m 07 s, the DTM set in 33 m 38 s.
- An unsuffixed archive name is the DSM. The DTM name ends in `-dtm`.
- The DTM is the closer analog to mapterhorn's own production sources, which
  are national bare-earth models. The DSM is the like-for-like comparison
  against GLO-30, itself a surface model.
- GEM-15 predicts its DTM from its DSM with a model, so the DTM is the more
  experimental band, and it is weak under closed canopy (bias to +9.4 m).
- DTM minus DSM is a usable height above ground on flat terrain only. At a
  zoom 13 pixel of ~9.55 m the two independently resampled rasters can differ
  on a ridge by more than the real gap. Measured on bare rock: 0.75 m at the
  Toubkal summit against 8.25 m on the slope below it. Over a filled void the
  gap is exactly 0, because GLO-30 supplies the same surface to both bands.
- Encoding: Mapzen terrarium, 512 px lossless WebP, PMTiles spec v3,
  clustered, minimum zoom 0. Decode with
  elevation = (R * 256 + G + B / 256) − 32768.
- MapLibre: `raster-dem` source, `"encoding": "terrarium"`,
  `"tileSize": 512` (not 256), `maxzoom` per archive.
- **The PMTiles header bounds are the whole world in all three files**, a
  defect of the fork's bundle_area.py. Use the collection extent instead.
  Tiles present: Catalonia 0 to 5.625E / 36.598 to 45.089N; Cusco 73.125W to
  70.3125W / 16.636S to 11.178S; High Atlas 8.4375W to 5.625W / 29.535N to
  34.307N. Real elevation covers only the one-degree GEM-15 cells inside.
- Terrarium has no nodata value, so tiles outside those cells read 0 m.
  Most of the ~10,930 tiles in each archive are such flat tiles, so tile
  count says nothing about coverage.
- GEM-15's voids (water plus a 9 m buffer, and more) are filled from
  Copernicus GLO-30 at 30 m, converted EGM2008 to EGM96, feathered 3 px.
  Filled pixels are unmarked. Draw with these; measure with the gem-15 COGs.
- Heights are orthometric on the EGM96 geoid (EPSG:5773), not ellipsoidal
  and not EGM2008.
- The finding: Mapterhorn's maxzoom rule gives a 15 m source zoom 13 only
  below about 38.3 degrees of latitude. Catalonia therefore lands at zoom 12,
  the same depth GLO-30 gets there. Zoom 14 depth is unreachable for a 15 m
  source at any latitude under that rule.
- DSM probes decoded from the published archives, 2026-11-15: Sau reservoir
  403.50 m (NaN in GEM-15, so the void fill ran), Montserrat 702.00 m,
  Cusco 1973.75 m, Toubkal summit 4108.50 m.
- DTM at the same points: 403.50, 701.50, 1968.50, 4107.75 m. Barcelona
  Eixample (2.1627E 41.3917N) reads 40.00 m DSM against 35.00 m DTM.
- Each archive's own PMTiles metadata declares only
  `attribution: "© Mapterhorn"`. Set the full attribution yourself.
- Licences: CC-BY-4.0 with "This dataset is produced by Google"; the
  Copernicus WorldDEM-30 Article 6(b) modified-data notice; BSD-3 credit for
  the Mapterhorn pipeline, as a tool, from an unmerged fork.

Key URLs

- Collection: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/mapterhorn-gem15/collection.json
- Catalonia DSM: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/mapterhorn-gem15/mapterhorn-gem15-barcelona.pmtiles
- Catalonia DTM: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/mapterhorn-gem15/mapterhorn-gem15-barcelona-dtm.pmtiles
- Cusco DSM: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/mapterhorn-gem15/mapterhorn-gem15-cusco.pmtiles
- Cusco DTM: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/mapterhorn-gem15/mapterhorn-gem15-cusco-dtm.pmtiles
- High Atlas DSM: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/mapterhorn-gem15/mapterhorn-gem15-atlas.pmtiles
- High Atlas DTM: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/mapterhorn-gem15/mapterhorn-gem15-atlas-dtm.pmtiles
- Elevation source collection: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/gem-15/collection.json
- Live comparison: https://portolan-mirrors.github.io/gem-15-catalog/maplibre-terrain/mapterhorn-gem15.html
- The fork and its notes: https://github.com/cholmes/mapterhorn/blob/gem-15-source/NOTES.md
- The issue that prompted it: https://github.com/mapterhorn/mapterhorn/issues/368
- GEM-15 preprint: https://doi.org/10.31223/X55N75

Documentation

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): footprints, a runnable tile-decoding recipe, and
  the quirks that produce silently wrong answers. Read this before writing
  code against the archives.
- [README.md](README.md): the experiment, the per-area table, the maxzoom
  result, the probe readings, a MapLibre snippet, and the attribution stack.
- [collection.json](collection.json): STAC 1.1 metadata, six archive assets
  with file sizes and checksums, three styles on the DSM, and a thumbnail.
  A style renders the DTM after one url change.
